Alex W: afternoon check-in: shipped hotpatch to reduce KV eviction on long-tail sessions. TL;DR: adjusted TTL heuristic + bumped aux-model cache size. Observed perf: p95 decode latency down ~12% on >2k seq. PR #4371 — please review. Any blockers?

Priya S: nice. noticed host-7 CPU +5% after rollout. digging into eviction logs and gc patterns. will rollback if it keeps rising.

Jordan: thanks — running batch_size sweep end-to-end. preliminary: batching window 12ms -> sweet spot around 24ms for throughput/latency tradeoff. will post numbers soon.

Samir: pinged on the PR, left a comment about metric tags (route/model). also found a flaky test in runtime-core related to kv eviction timing; creating an issue.

ci-bot: deploy: canary -> host-7, host-9. monitors snapshot: KV_hit_rate 86.9% -> 89.7%, p50_token_latency 23ms -> 20ms.

Priya S: small update — host-7 CPU growth due to GC flushes when cache resizing happened. switched to async flush, re-deploying canary now.

Jordan: benchmark numbers (end-to-end synthetic): p50 token latency 23ms -> 20ms, p95 110ms -> 98ms, tokens/s +12% at batch window 24ms. attaching CSV to PR description after I clean it up.

Alex W: two asks: (1) Jordan — add a simple plot and summary to PR description so reviewers can eyeball perf. (2) Priya — if you need to rollback, escalate in #incidents and tag me. Any other blockers?

Samir: FYI infra plan — I'll re-run quantized-kernel sweep on the alpha model set tonight; might spike GPU usage briefly. heads-up for oncall.

Priya S: ack. reassigning to @Alex W for escalation if rollback required. no other blockers from me atm.

Alex W: :thumbsup: thanks. quick config snippet we used for the hotpatch:
```yaml
cache:
  base_size: 1GB
  eviction_policy: lru_ttl
  ttl_ms: 600000
microbatch:
  max_delay_ms: 24
  max_size: 64
```

Jordan: cool — I'll add the plots and results to #4371 and mark it ready for review. that's my update, signing off.
